decisions.reason: The MMAK concept builds on Doppstadt's established mobile processing know-how and has a documented customer saving of more than 600,000 euros, so the firm with its own R&D can interpret and extend these results.
The slow-speed shredder sits at the core of the firm's knowledge base and has kept a page of its own in both years, although the 2024 shredder line could absorb it.
As the flagship modular plant line with a named reference customer and quantified savings, it builds directly on existing competence and fits the firm's stated modular direction.
This new multi-model slow-speed shredder line is close to core expertise and fits the cleaner-machine-generation strategy, so the firm can assimilate early market feedback.
The spiral shaft screens extend the firm's screening knowledge into a multi-model line that its in-house R&D and university cooperation can develop further.
